description: Hashtag Explore: session-raced native grid, Apify only on miss. Max 50. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 50). Flat 2 credits per call.

mediaType.description: all (default) or reels — return only Reels/clips when set to reels.

q.description: Hashtag without the # (min 2 characters). One token — spaces are 400 HASHTAG_HAS_SPACES.

name: instagram_hashtag_search
